workflows.name: rifi_comparative_analysis
workflows.intent: Compare half-life and mRNA intensity at time 0 between two conditions to analyze transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation.
input: differential_expression.rda (probe/bin level differential expression data frame with logFC_int and P.Value columns)
workflows.stages:
1. Load and join data from two conditions using loading_fun, joining_data_row, and joining_data_column.
2. Calculate penalties for half-life and intensity using penalties (or make_pen).
3. Perform fragmentation for half-life and intensity using fragment_HL and fragment_inty.
4. Run statistical tests on fragments using statistics.
5. Visualize the comparative fragments using rifi_visualization_comparison.
6. Adjust half-life and intensity fragments and merge with genome annotation using adjusting_HLToInt.
7. Generate summary plots using figures_fun.
8. Preprocess GFF3 files using gff3_preprocess.
workflows.code:
data(stats_se_cdt1)
data(stats_se_cdt2)
data(differential_expression)
inp_s <-  
    loading_fun(stats_se_cdt1, stats_se_cdt2, differential_expression)[[1]]
head(inp_s, 5)
inp_f <- 
    loading_fun(stats_se_cdt1, stats_se_cdt2, differential_expression)[[2]]
head(inp_f, 5)

data(inp_s)
data(inp_f)
data_combined_minimal <- 
joining_data_row(input1 = inp_s, input2 = inp_f)
head(data_combined_minimal, 5)

data(data_combined_minimal)
df_comb_minimal <- joining_data_column(data = data_combined_minimal)
head(df_comb_minimal, 5)

data(df_comb_minimal) 
penalties_df <- penalties(df_comb_minimal)[[1]]
pen_HL <- penalties(df_comb_minimal)[[2]]
pen_int <- penalties(df_comb_minimal)[[3]]
head(penalties_df, 5)

penalties_df <-
    fragment_HL(
    probe = penalties_df,
    cores = 2,
    pen = pen_HL[[1]][[9]],
    pen_out = pen_HL[[1]][[10]]
)

fragment_int <-
    fragment_inty(
        probe = penalties_df,
        cores = 2,
        pen = pen_int[[1]][[9]],
        pen_out = pen_int[[1]][[10]]
    )
head(fragment_int, 5)

data(fragment_int)
stats_df_comb_minimal <- statistics(data= fragment_int)[[1]]
df_comb_uniq_minimal <- statistics(data= fragment_int)[[2]]
